details.description: GPT-5.6 Terra is OpenAI's balanced, mid-tier model in the GPT-5.6 family, launched July 13, 2026 between the flagship Sol and the lightweight Luna. AWS Bedrock's model card describes it as the balanced model for everyday production work, delivering superior performance to GPT-5.5 while completing tasks with fewer output tokens. It takes text and image input and produces text output, with a knowledge cutoff of February 16, 2026 and reasoning effort adjustable from none up to max.
advantages: AWS Bedrock's model card states Terra delivers superior performance to GPT-5.5 while completing tasks with fewer output tokens.
Scores 42 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at max reasoning effort, well above the comparable-model median of 25.

Supports reasoning effort levels from none to max, plus function calling, structured outputs, file search, web search, code interpreter, hosted shell, computer use and MCP tool use via the Responses API.
disadvantages: Output is text-only; the model does not generate images, audio or video.
Not compatible with Live sessions, Realtime, Assistants, fine-tuning, embeddings, or audio/video features.
use_cases: Code generation and code assistance at production scale

evaluations.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (max reasoning effort)

notes: Catalog facts give max_input_tokens as [922000, 1000000]; OpenAI's docs describe a 1,050,000-token context window (922,000 max input plus up to 128,000 output) and AWS's card rounds this to '1M tokens', both consistent with that range across hosts, so nothing was restated or flagged as a conflict. Artificial Analysis's page for this model did not carry a superseded/deprecated banner (unlike the Sol page), so no successor claim is made here. Could not open OpenAI's own launch posts (openai.com/index/gpt-5-6, advancing-the-price-performance-frontier-with-gpt-5-6) or the Help Center article, which returned HTTP 403 on every fetch attempt; relied on OpenAI's API docs subdomain and AWS's model card instead.
